summary: Before uninstalling containerized AAP to reinstall with preserved databases, save secret keys with `podman secret inspect --showsecret`, then run ansible.containerized_installer.uninstall.
questions: How do I uninstall containerized AAP?
How do I keep the database when uninstalling AAP?
How do I get controller_secret_key from podman?

answer_card.title: Uninstall but keep the databases
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman secret list
podman secret inspect --showsecret controller_secret_key | jq -r .[].SecretData
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.uninstall
```
Save the secret keys before uninstalling if you will reinstall on the same databases.
